'''Braised scyk belly''' was a meal made from fatty [[Scyk/Legends|scyk]] meat. It was one of the dishes served at the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] event on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Cooking" />
